# MAX78000 vendor headers

Device and register headers of the MAX78000, imported unmodified from the
Analog Devices MSDK (Apache-2.0):

- repository: https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/msdk
- path: `Libraries/CMSIS/Device/Maxim/MAX78000/Include`
- commit: fbcdf639d7deea2e518108b0a82b50b3a8a4c2f3

Only the headers needed by the RIOT port are imported.
